# Timeline

## Summary
Base-realm timeline presentation component. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/components/timeline` (named export `Timeline`).

## API
- `@model` — the card or value list the timeline presents
- `@config` — `TimelineConfiguration` controlling ordering and rendering

## Usage
```gts
import { Timeline } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/components/timeline';

<Timeline @model={{@model}} @config={{this.timelineConfig}} />
```
Typically fed by activity-style cards ordered by a datetime field. The
shared-realm Activity block covers the matching data shape.
